temporal_timeline.leakage_prevention: Hyperparameter tuning (Optuna) and ensemble weighting were performed strictly on the internal validation window (2011-10-11 to 2011-11-09). The final 30-day holdout test set (2011-11-10 to 2011-12-09) was strictly sequestered and untouched until post-tuning evaluation.

ensemble_weights: Dynamic inverse-error validation weights (mean w_prophet ≈ 0.54, w_lstm ≈ 0.46)
production_model_status: Retained Phase 5 Prophet + PyTorch LSTM Hybrid Ensemble as primary production model
model_selection_rationale: While Optuna tuning improved internal validation MAE by 15.1% (57.12 vs 67.27), the default regularization configuration exhibited superior out-of-sample holdout generalization (Holdout MAE: 61.29 vs 65.43, RMSE: 90.84 vs 98.14). In accordance with conservative MLOps governance principles, the Phase 5 ensemble is preserved as the production standard, while the tuned configuration is registered as a validated challenger.
